shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
cat package.json
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log -3 --oneline
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
npm ls ajv --depth=0 || true
ls node_modules/ajv/dist/2020* 2>/dev/null || true
rg '\"ajv\"|node_modules/ajv' package-lock.json | head -20"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts::ToolRegistry logs the rejected field and expected type without logging its value"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show origin/main:package.json | rg '\"version\"' -m1
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs \"src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts::ToolRegistry logs the rejected field and expected type without logging its value\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write package.json package-lock.json
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --coverage=false --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry logs the rejected field and expected type without logging its value$'"'
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p'
git diff -- package-lock.json package.json .lore/dod.md
rg '\\[validated by' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "Log schema validation rejections safely"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD')\" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --count '@{upstream}..HEAD'"
